coverage_note: The sessions of 13 January, 17 March and 5 May 1954 and the Gelinier presentation of the Klein paper - the places where the term family carries weight. The pass records a finding about the whole file: nothing here is Husserlian Konstitution. The register is psychoanalytic and largely ordinary - a group constitutes itself, prejudices constitute a community, Klein's 'constitutional capacity' is the hereditary sense - with the technical uses being the constitution of the Idealich, of good and bad objects, and of ignorance as a polar term. No unit carries a stratum: the commentary has no chronology.json entry, although it dates each session in its own headings.

units.claim: It is elsewhere than within a single body that everything elaborated in analytic expression is constituted, namely in a certain determinate relation.
units.quote: it is *elsewhere* than within a single body that everything we will elaborate in analytic expression is constituted — namely, in a certain determinate relation.

units.claim: The complete reconstitution of the history of the subject is the essential, constitutive, structural element of analytic progress.
units.quote: the complete reconstitution of the history of the subject* is the essential, constitutive, structural element of analytic progress.

units.claim: Klein is reported, without justification, to ascribe to Dick a constitutional capacity of his ego to tolerate anxiety.
units.quote: She thinks (without justification) Dick has a *constitutional capacity of his ego to tolerate anxiety*. She thinks his *genital drives* were particularly *premature*

units.claim: What limits the young subject is that he is wholly in reality in a pure state, unconstituted, what is not differentiated.
units.quote: he is wholly in *reality in a pure state, unconstituted* — what is *not differentiated*.

units.claim: The development of the infinite world of equivalent objects of human interest is what constitutes a human world.
units.quote: the development of that infinite world of objects which constitutes a *human world*. And her text is precious because she is, so to speak, an experienced therapist

units.claim: Into the object-system are integrated the whole sum of prejudices constituting a cultural community, psychological prejudices included.
units.quote: are integrated the whole sum of *prejudices* constituting a *cultural community*, up to and including psychological prejudices, from those most elaborated by scientific work to the most naïve and spontaneous

units.claim: Exchanges of introjections and projections between analysand and analyst carry to the level of the mechanisms of constitution of good and bad objects.
units.quote: carrying us especially to the level of the mechanisms of constitution of *good and bad objects*, broached in the practice of the English school by Melanie Klein

units.claim: The libido, as constitutive of objects of interest, distributes itself, constituted by a certain emission by the subject of his libidinal cathexes.
units.quote: this libido, as constitutive of objects of interest, *distributes itself*, constituted by a certain *emission by the subject of his libidinal cathexes*

units.claim: What is at issue is the constitution of the Idealich and not of the Ichideal, the essentially imaginary, specular form of the genesis of the ego.
units.quote: It is fundamentally a question of what concerns the constitution of the *Idealich*, not of the *Ichideal*. The essentially imaginary, specular form of the genesis, of the fundamentally imaginary origin of the ego.

units.claim: Ignorance is constituted in a polar way relative to the virtual position of a truth to be attained; it is a state of the subject insofar as he speaks.
units.quote: *Ignorance is constituted in a polar way relative to the virtual position of a truth to be attained*: it is a state of the subject *insofar as he speaks*

units.claim: The frequent failure of the synthesis shows a quite particular fact of man in his relation to the constituting images of his world.
units.quote: showing that there is a *quite particular fact of man in his relation to the constituting images of his world*. What in man responds to the *innate knowledge* that is the *guide of life* in the balance of the living?

absences.expected_because: Hyppolite's commentary on Freud's Verneinung is the one sustained piece of philosophical exposition in the seminar, on the genesis of judgment and of the object out of negation - the place where a philosophical vocabulary of constitution would be at home. Its 3,010 words carry no term of the family.
